task_material.issue:
# Tuple defaults are not applied to omitted trailing items

Parsing a tuple with a trailing defaulted item returns an array that omits the defaulted value when the input stops before that position.

Reproduce with a two-item tuple whose second string schema has the default `fallback`, then parse `['present']`. The result should preserve `present` and materialize the defaulted second item.

candidate_information.text: Do not change tuple declaration syntax.
A declared position carrying a default must receive that default when the input omits it.
The tuple parser classifies every absent position at or beyond its optional-input boundary as skippable, including schemas that produce a defined output from absent input.
An undefined supplied explicitly in the input must be preserved as an explicit undefined.
Behavior relied on by the existing test suite must continue to hold.
Rest elements must keep their current behavior and issue ordering.
In the base version, `$ZodTuple` supplies a value that `handleTupleResult` receives (call).
Trailing positions whose schema yields no value for absent input must not be appended to the result.
The base version of `packages/zod/src/v4/core/schemas.ts` between lines 2635 and 2714 is relevant to this task.
Parsing a tuple must produce a value at every declared position whose schema yields a defined result for absent input, while positions that yield nothing for absent input stay absent.
Synchronous and asynchronous parsing must produce the same result.
Parsing the two-item tuple [string, string.default('fallback')] with the one-item input ['present'] returns the one-item output ['present'] with length 1.
